highlights: OpenAI accelerates its hardware and software vertical integration, unveiling the custom 'Jalapeño' inference silicon alongside launching GPT-5.6 in the Kiro developer environment.
The translation of AI agents into physical spaces gains standardization and cost-efficiency via Anthropic's Model Hardware Standard (MHS) and Hugging Face's $399 Microduck bipedal robot.
Web-native agentic tooling reaches production-grade maturity with Google expanding Managed Agents with Gemini 3.6 Flash and Vercel open-sourcing vgpu for deterministic agent shaders.

agents.title: Anthropic Model Hardware Standard (MHS) Research Preview
agents.summary: Anthropic released a shared driver specification over MCP, allowing AI agents to safely discover and operate physical laboratory and manufacturing equipment with safety limits enforced in the driver.

agents.title: Code-as-World: Agentic Video-to-Physics Compilation
agents.summary: This framework compiles real-world video into editable, verified MuJoCo scene code, establishing a closed agentic loop to train models in rigorous, interactive physical reasoning.

agents.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API
agents.summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.6 Flash and tool hook capabilities directly into the Gemini API Managed Agents ecosystem, streamlining the orchestration of reliable, multi-turn AI workflows.

models.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.6 in Kiro
models.summary: Offering advanced reasoning and software engineering planning capabilities, OpenAI launched GPT-5.6 in the Kiro environment with a focus on optimization and cost-efficiency for builders.

models.title: Google Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
models.summary: This production update for native multimodal video generation introduces up to 40-second scene extensions, precise first-and-last frame pinning, 4K upscaling, and character consistency mapping.

models.title: Cohere Releases Parse 5 (v5.0)
models.summary: A 2.3B parameter document intelligence vision-language model designed to cheaply and securely convert enterprise PDFs, charts, and slide decks into highly structured, clean Markdown documents.

tools.title: Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics Unveil Microduck
tools.summary: A $399 open-source, 25 cm bipedal robot with an Apache-2.0 training stack that enables desk-side sim-to-real reinforcement learning using MuJoCo and ONNX neural policies.

tools.title: Vercel AI Open-Sources vgpu Library
tools.summary: vgpu treats WGSL shader files as importable TypeScript modules, allowing developers to execute deterministic GPU-accelerated effects in browsers, headless Node.js, and CI environments.

tools.title: Streaming Robotics Data Loop with Strands, LeRobot, and HF Buckets
tools.summary: This integration combines Amazon's Strands Agents with LeRobot and Hugging Face Storage Buckets, enabling developers to record physical demonstrations, train models, and deploy neural policies from a single location.

companies.title: OpenAI Unveils Custom Inference Silicon 'Jalapeño'
companies.summary: OpenAI announced its custom-designed 'Jalapeño' inference chip, reporting industry-leading throughput, low latency, and highly efficient energy consumption profiles for next-generation frontier models.

companies.title: OpenAI Wounds Down Cursor Contract Post-SpaceX Acquisition
companies.summary: Following SpaceX's acquisition of the popular AI-native code editor Cursor, OpenAI announced it is winding down its contract to provide commercial frontier models to the Cursor platform.

companies.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face Post-Incident Joint Security Report
companies.summary: OpenAI released findings and remediation paths following a joint security investigation with Hugging Face, detailing new measures for pipeline hardening, access control, and model integrity checking.

learning.title: Kaggle AI Agents Intensive Guide and Recap
learning.summary: Google details the curriculum and developer takeaways from its 353,000-person, zero-cost Kaggle intensive on creating, executing, and monitoring complex autonomous agent graphs.

learning.title: Ensemble Weather Forecasting with NVIDIA Earth2Studio
learning.summary: A developer guide to setting up Earth2Studio, utilizing PyTorch, and building custom turbine-level wind diagnostics to transform global atmospheric forecasts into local energy predictions.

learning.title: Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
learning.summary: A hands-on technical tutorial for training late-interaction, multi-vector embedding models to build highly accurate and robust document search pipelines.
